name: Head and shoulders neckline break
idea: After a fall, three swing lows with the middle one lowest and the shoulders about level; a signal on the first close over the line of the two highs between them (the inverse pattern). The mirror after a rise: the head and shoulders under its neckline. Wrong beyond the right shoulder.

params.label: Swing size (the swing degree read)
params.help: Which swings are read: 0 is the smallest, 3 the largest. Larger swings need more history. Reference: 0.

params.label: Bars for the average true range the tolerances are measured in
params.help: Bars for the average true range the tolerances are measured in. Reference: 14.

params.label: Head and shoulders: shoulders within this share of the head's height
params.help: The two shoulders within this share of the head's height of each other. Reference: 0.5.

params.label: Bars a pattern stays watched
params.help: Bars a pattern stays watched (after its pullback, its second low or its second rim). Reference: 30.
